> LIDARs are some awesome pieces of tech but.... they are pretty  expensive! Especially the 3D LIDAR.  PARALLAX is an affordable, open-source 3D LiDAR that uses time-of-flight (ToF) sensors and a dual-axis stepper-driven scanning mechanism to generate 3D point clouds, making spatial perception more accessible for robotics and autonomous systems.
